snippet.title: Treasure Seekers: Follow the Ghosts
snippet.description:
Treasure Seekers: Follow the Ghosts for PC: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/7607/treasure-seekers-follow-the-ghosts/index.html

Treasure Seekers: Follow the Ghosts for Mac: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/7957/mac/treasure-seekers-follow-the-ghosts/index.html

Jump into an exciting adventure as you help Nelly and Tom free some unlucky ghosts who are being trapped by an evil alchemist! Use your Hidden Object skills to explore a mysterious world, and discover valuable clues. Track down the necessary items to free the dead ancestor of Cardinal House, a shaman, and many other characters in Treasure Seekers: Follow the Ghosts! Stop the evil alchemist and save the day!

  * Gorgeous graphics
  * Free the trapped ghosts!
  * Check out our complete game walkthrough at http://www.bigfishgames.com/blog/treasure-seekers-follow-the-ghosts-walkthrough/
  * Get the Strategy Guide at http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/7504/treasure-seekers-follow-ghosts-strategy-guide/index.html
    * For a more in depth experience, check out the Collector's Edition at http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/7251/treasure-seekers-follow-ghosts-collectors/index.html
